integrity: Analytical proofs supplemented by exact finite enumeration. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Nearest facet-plane distance determined only within universal factors; the stochastic limit uses uniform facet sampling and does not address finite full-shell counts. Earlier general cactus-facet covariance already covers the first two moments; these are not claimed as new. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A parity-sharp farthest-facet law and a Watson limit for cycle symmetric-edge polytopes
